alice_sales: Heads-up: Sentinel Inc legal asked for SOC2 excerpt, a one-page pen-test letter, and confirmation we can retain logs for 90 days during the POC. They also want to know if Dedicated adds any onboarding fees for a 30-day trial.

rachel_pre_sales: Quick checklist: SOC2 summary (redacted), controls CSV, pen-test attestation, iso scope excerpt, network diagram. Can we bundle those?

amit_security: We can provide a redacted SOC2 summary and a prefilled pen-test attestation letter. Full pen-test reports require NDA. Hosted default retention = 30d; 90d available via addendum or for Dedicated with log-addon.

alice_sales: Sentinel prefers SFTP for uploads. Ops, can we do it?

infra_ops: We recommend presigned S3 + scoped creds. Managed SFTP is possible but slower to provision. Example presign command we provide in packets. We'll also add lifecycle (auto-delete) and a SHA256 manifest for non-repudiation.

rachel_pre_sales: I'll draft a short procurement blurb: - Dedicated small pool: one-time setup ~$3k plus usage - Hosted trial with credits: no setup fee - Egress billed at cloud provider rates.

amit_security: I'll prefill the attestation and mark fields for legal signature. ETA 2 hours.

artifact-bot: Uploaded "sentinel_poc/1799999999/" (4 files) -- https://storage.internal/redwood/sentinel_poc/1799999999

alice_sales: Perfect. I'll send the packet once prefilled attestation and cost blurb are attached. Call scheduled tomorrow 9am PT.
